messages:
lara: FYI onboarding hit: wheel installs but CLI not present (redwoodctl missing) after `pip install dist/sampleapp-0.3.0.whl` :thinking:
lara: import `sampleapp` works, bin not on PATH
pete: check pyproject: do we have `[tool.poetry.scripts]` -> `redwoodctl = "sampleapp.cli:main"`?
lara: yes, and `poetry build` shows the script in logs but installed wheel lacks it
noah: leftover packaging files can interfere. any `setup.cfg` or `setup.py` lying around?
lara: there was an old `setup.cfg`. removed it and rebuilt, CLI appears after `pip install`.
pete: common trap. also pipx can silently change behavior when package name has hyphens vs underscores. recommend docs note the difference.
noah: unrelated: new hire hit `ImportError` from `typing_extensions` when running async sample. lockfile pinned 4.5 but we need >=4.6 for Protocol support on py3.11
pete: action items: 1) remove legacy setup files from sample templates, 2) update quickstart to use `poetry build` explicitly, 3) add CI check that installs wheel into clean venv and asserts CLI exists (`which redwoodctl`), 4) add `typing-extensions >=4.6` to sample dev deps
ci-bot: created task RED-DEVEX-433 assigned to @lara: "sampleapp wheel missing console script when legacy setup.cfg present"
lara: I'll open PRs for template cleanup + CI job. will paste links here when ready
noah: add a tiny troubleshooting snippet to onboarding: `unzip -p dist/*.whl "*.data/entry_points.txt" || unzip -p dist/*.whl "{sampleapp}/EGG-INFO/entry_points.txt"`
pete: good call. closing thread for now. :tada:
